newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Alcatel to cut 470 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Alcatel to cut 470 jobs.

text.p: Alcatel Schweiz AG, a subsidiary of France's Alcatel Alsthom, said it would cut 470 jobs by end-1998 as part of a restructuring of business in Switzerland.

Alcatel said the decision had been made following Swiss Telecom PTT's decision that it no longer would buy switching equipment from Alcatel, but also the structural changes taking place in the industry.
Earlier this month Swiss Telcom named Ascom Holding AG and Siemens AG as its two only offical suppliers of telephone exchange equipment from 1998.
As part of the restructuring, Alcatel said it would expand its local software and support activities to offer a full supply of services in Switzerladn.
Alcatel Schweiz's telecommunications equipment division employs 1,470 people and generated turnover of 452 million Swiss francs in 1996.
